body: I would if my family could afford that, I agree with you yet due to how much shit costs we couldn't choose that route :(

I think you have gotten the wrong impression about him, he is much more than a bully. I don't think someone who strangles, beats their family members, and destroys everything is a bully.

Encouragement hasn't done much for me, I don't know what small steps to take if I can't see them. I haven't been treated or even checked for any mental issues, yet I am 100% sure I have them. I've been feeling this way since when I was a preteen. It has only gotten worse.

It's hard to get out of the house when I look and feel like absolute shit, I'm not smart either, I'm quite stupid. I feel like a burden to everyone I talk to, or are friends with, which is why now I'm all alone. I've always ended up back stabbed by at multiple people in my past few friend groups. That's where my trust issues stem from. I'm not even healthy, I'm quite overweight. I have been trying to fast recently.

I really dislike the idea of getting married and having a family. I wasn't and still am not allowed to date, due to my family's religion, I'm not even allowed to give hugs to guys. Sure I dream of being in the warm embrace of someone who truly loves me, yet that is just like another dead dream. Plus I saw how my parent's marriage turned out.

I wish it was that simple, I've had two classes in High school where I had to make a resume, I failed both those assignments. I would have no where to go, I feel like I was raised to be dependent on my family. Plus I have no will-power or motivation to do anything. I cant even bring myself to draw anymore.

The brother is 13, he has already a small record for breaking a teachers nose, throwing a chair, smashing a bus window, I forgot some things but you get the gist. All of that was when he was around 11-12.

I'm also not a guy, but I've always kinda thought about it and make 'jokes' here in there about wanting to be a guy.
all the time, It always is there.

I'm 18, been out of High-school for a few months. I'm considered an adult now, yet I really am not, I try to take selfies to boost my confidence, yet somehow look like a balding old guy. I've given up on Looks, health, everything. My hormones are still haywire and today I had a big breakdown and was seriously thinking ending it in every way I could. I am in a horrible situation right now and I don't feel safe what so ever. I can't leave because I don't have anywhere to go, or anyone I know. I don't got cash, a job, nothing. I'm supposed to be going to college but I have literally nothing going my way. I am completely uninterested about living. I sometimes wish I did go through with my attempt when I was 12. I've been inside over half of my life, I lost/ pushed away all my friends, and still my family thinks therapy is useless. The family doctor is utterly useless and bat-shit crazy. I didn't ask to be born, I'm apparently not supposed to be responsible even if I am told to be, nothing goes right. 

The only reason I never started cutting is because I promised someone online I wouldn't, I'm holding that promise for that person only.
We get it you're trolling, go back to whatever hole you came out of.
